description: This header file declares exported API functions for the BREE Module Container Object within the BroadWay Service Delivery System, detailing creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: BreeCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates a module container instance for BREE with provided contexts.

methods.name: BreeMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Module Container Object for BREE with provided contexts.

methods.name: BreeMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified BREE Module Container Object.

methods.name: BreeMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects within the BREE container.

methods.name: BreeMcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the BREE Module Container Object.
